meta.purpose: Damage-calc formulas only. Every entry cites a wiki/DE source. Engine: src/engine.js.

quantization.note: Update 40.0 changed scale from 1/16 to 1/32 of unmodded base (including Valence).
quantization.damageMods: Multiply final quantized values; they do not change scale (wiki Damage/Calculation).

arsenalTotal.formula: base * (1 + elemental% + physDist_i * physBonus_i) * (1 + damage%) * multishot
arsenalTotal.note: Arsenal screen omits faction, falloff, and quantization.

crit.expectedMultiplier: (1 - f) * (1 + t*(CD-1)) + f * (1 + (t+1)*(CD-1)) where t=floor(CC), f=CC-t
crit.headcrit: Doubles weapon base crit multiplier; relative crit-damage bonuses still apply. Flat crit-damage bonuses are not doubled.
crit.headcritFlag: Not every head: Corpus humanoids, most Murmur/Techrot default off (Enemy_Body_Parts).

factionAndDots.note: Vulnerability (Torxica spores) is multiplicative with Bane/Roar, not additive (Dual_Coda_Torxica).

elements.order: Mod slots top-left→bottom-right, then innate/Valence primaries in HCET: heat, cold, electricity, toxin

valence.appliesAs: base damage (raises baseTotal before elemental % and quantization scale)
valence.fusion: min(1.1 * max(a,b), 60%), floor to 0.1 percent points, then >=58% → 60%
